work_handoff.title: N22｜People in the Flow — Ning Observational POV｜Candidate 02
requirements: Generate exactly one N22 Candidate 02 PNG and stop for Product Owner review.
Generation mode = CLEAN REGENERATION. Candidate 01 is negative composition/lighting evidence only and must not be used as a pixel-edit base.
Primary visual read = a passing observational slice of a larger group, not three named characters posing together.
Su Xiaoxiao is the primary readable seed: off-center, naturally integrated, not looking at camera, no glamour or isolated hero pose.
Liao Jian is the secondary readable seed: laterally or depth-offset from Su, different body angle, preferably partially overlapped, never a matched central hero pair.
Guang Yong is tertiary/partial: smaller, deeper or partly occluded; short slightly chubby silhouette useful; full frontal face not required.
Wen Qingya is intentionally deferred and should not be intentionally rendered/readable.
Use unnamed foreground shoulders/bodies/silhouettes and deeper anonymous figures to break ensemble staging.
No more than two named faces should dominate first glance.
REFERENCE ORDER DOES NOT EQUAL SCREEN POSITION, LEFT/RIGHT ORDER, BLOCKING ORDER OR PROMINENCE EQUALITY.
Scene remains CASTLE_ENTRANCE → INTERIOR TRANSITION ZONE.
Camera turned farther into the interior, away from the open door.
Warm dim interior should dominate approximately 80–90% of perceived frame.
Exterior bright region should be approximately ≤10–15% and mostly off-frame or a narrow partial opening.
No broad white daylight beam on floor; floor mostly dark, warm and low-reflectance.
Wall sconces/candles remain primary visible practical light sources; skin natural; no global orange cast.
Neil and Jun Luyuan should not become unintended subjects.
No exact visible-person count is required.
exclusions: Wen Qingya as intentional readable seed
three named characters lined up together
Su and Liao as central matched hero pair
more than two named faces dominating first glance
bright exterior daylight dominating the frame
broad white daylight reflection across floor
